approach_description: Shor's algorithm for ECDLP on 3-bit ECC key. Curve E: y² = x³ + 2x + 3 over GF(7). Group order n = 6. Two quantum registers of 7 qubits each prepared in uniform superposition. Oracle computes aP + bQ via lookup table. Inverse QFT applied to both registers. Key extracted via continued fractions and lattice reduction on measurements. Method is general and scales to 256-bit keys with sufficient qubits.
